name: arkoffice
description: AI-native office suite (docs, sheets, slides, pdf)

scripts.test: npm run test -w @arkoffice/i18n && npm run test -w @arkoffice/electron-utils && npm run test -w @arkoffice/docx-engine && npm run test -w @arkoffice/file-parse && npm run test -w @arkoffice/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @arkoffice/pptx-render && npm run test -w @arkoffice/ai-search && npm run test -w @arkoffice/agent-core && npm run test -w @arkoffice/ai-provider && npm run test -w @arkoffice/project-store && npm run test -w @arkoffice/docs && npm run test -w @arkoffice/sheets && npm run test -w @arkoffice/shell && npm run test -w @arkoffice/slides && npm run test -w @arkoffice/pdf
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @arkoffice/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @arkoffice/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @arkoffice/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @arkoffice/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @arkoffice/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @arkoffice/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @arkoffice/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @arkoffice/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @arkoffice/ai-provider && npm run typecheck -w @arkoffice/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @arkoffice/ui && npm run typecheck -w @arkoffice/docs && npm run typecheck -w @arkoffice/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @arkoffice/shell && npm run typecheck -w @arkoffice/slides && npm run typecheck -w @arkoffice/pdf
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @arkoffice/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @arkoffice/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @arkoffice/slides" "npm run dev:renderer -w @arkoffice/pdf" "DOCS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 SHEETS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5174 SLIDES_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5175 PDF_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5176 npm run dev -w @arkoffice/shell"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @arkoffice/docs && npm run build -w @arkoffice/sheets && npm run build -w @arkoffice/slides && npm run build -w @arkoffice/pdf && npm run build -w @arkoffice/shell
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:mac -w @arkoffice/shell
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:win -w @arkoffice/shell
